data.body: Fixed in change 3385, merged as 5d519764f20 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1; make verify rc=0). The README now states the 5.5-era band (about 1.8x Opus-only to 2.1x account-wide), the per-direction factors (about 1.56x; cache read about 3.1x), that cache reads drive the excess, and that comparisons must use settled days because Cost Explorer lags within the current UTC day (the ~3x sighting). Two new tests in tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py read CEILING from handler.py and pin the band to the dollar-weighted ratio (about 1.82) and the measured account-wide 2.04, ratios only; both failed RED on the old README. No price, threshold, attachment, handler or Terraform change. Possible future story (not filed): exact-match per-ModelId rate table.
